values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (April-October) basic $15, electric 30A $27, electric 50A $29, sewer/electric/water 50A $35, family electric 50A $46; off-season (November-March) $14 / $23 / $25 / $29 / $40. Rates include sales tax; a family site (two pads) takes one reservation fee.

fees.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/02/lake-ozarks-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('Basic $15 $14', 'Electric - 30 AMP $27 $23', 'Electric - 50 AMP $29 $25', '*Sewer/Electric/Water 50 AMP $35 $29', 'Family/Electric 50 AMP $46 $40') + lake-ozarks-2026-camping-fees.pdf (same figures), read 2026-11-07. The 18 basic sites are 27-69 ft on the booking grid, so a 23-ft rig fits the basic base.

values.note: $2 a night off year-round for seniors 65+, persons with disabilities, military and veterans; ask at payment, with proof.

discounts.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/02/lake-ozarks-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('A $2 PER NIGHT CAMPING DISCOUNT is available year-round for senior citizens (65 years and older), persons with disabilities, military and veterans'), read 2026-11-07

values.note: 164 campsites on the booking grid: Section 1 27 (25 electric 50A, 2 basic), Section 2 13 (12 electric 30A, 1 electric 50A), Section 3 45 (17 electric 50A, 25 electric 30A, 3 family electric 50A), Section 4 79 (24 sewer/electric/water 50A, 39 electric 50A, 16 basic). Pads 27-90 ft; every site fits 23 ft. Six yurts and eight outpost cabins besides.

note: Main campground of the park, in four sections on a wooded peninsula of Lake of the Ozarks; Section 4 runs along the shore near Public Beach 1. Watercraft and ATV trailers may be parked off the pad in the grass. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base, electric +12, full hookup +20 (2026 = 2027); sites 181 -> 164 on the grid (pads 27-90 ft), 50A/water/sewer, showers/laundry/dump/camper store, military $2, 12-month window, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30, reservations Mar 1-Nov 30 (Sections 1 and 4; Apr 1-Oct 31 for 2 and 3). PIN ~685 m off. Lakeview kept, with a lakefront lead for a few west-shore pads.
flags: PIN: stored 38.0772,-92.5708 is north of Section 1, ~685 m from the centre of the 164 UseDirect site points. Move to 38.0716,-92.5739 (centre of all sites).

SITES: stored 181 (from the old note) -> 164 on the booking grid (Section 1 27, Section 2 13, Section 3 45, Section 4 79). Section 4's facility names run to site 182 but numbers 112, 178-182 and some others are not on the grid.

WATERFRONT LEAD (lakefront, both ways checked): stored lakeview. Most of the campground sits on wooded ground 60-150 m from the shore (Section 2's pads 039-046 ~80-120 m from the east shore through forest; the south tip's 172-174 ~25-35 m above a wooded slope with the loop road between some of them and the water). But on the west shore of Section 4, sites 139, 155, 156, 158 and 159 sit ~15-30 m from the top of the bank with the loop road running inland of them, and their pads are only 1-3 m above normal pool (EPQS 202-204 m against Lake of the Ozarks' 660 ft / 201 m pool). The bank carries scattered trees (winter imagery, leafless); whether it is an open walkable apron or a rocky drop could not be settled from imagery, and no official site photo or per-site water tag was read. Lakeview kept; a closer look (booking-site photos of 139/158/159) may earn lakefront for those few sites.
